parsed.summary: The patch introduces a potential issue with string inputs and does not address the root cause of the bug.

issues.description: The patch attempts to sympify string inputs, but it does not handle the case where the input is a float string, which is the root cause of the issue. This could lead to incorrect behavior in other cases.
